adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, `save_host` unconditionally does `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` (no guard/strong params). If the request omits `embeddable_host` (or it’s not a hash), this will raise `NoMethodError` and produce a 500 instead of a controlled 4xx/validation error. This behavior is directly visible in the diff at `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`.
